correctness.rationale: For N≥3 equal-frequency oscillators with two internally synchronized clusters sizes p>q≥1 at β=π/2, direct subtraction of the exact discrete mean-field updates yields δ→F_B(δ)=δ+B(1-cosδ), B=K(p-q)/N>0. Uniform no-slip F_B((0,2π))⊂(0,2π] iff B≤min_{0<t<2π} t/(1-cos t)=B*=1.380050139689..., with unique minimizer t* solving tan(t*/2)=t*. For B in this range all non-finite-hitting lifted orbits are strictly increasing below 2π and converge there; the equality touching phase at B* hits in one step, and B>B* gives immediate overshoot examples, not post-slip dynamics. Gap x=2π-δ obeys x_next=x-B(1-cos x); reciprocal y=1/x satisfies y_next-y=B/2+B²/(4y)+O(y^-2). Since y~Bn/2 and the residual after subtracting (B/2)n+(B/2)log n is absolutely summable, there is an initial-condition-dependent finite C and o(1). Continuous-time exact integration yields no log correction. Independently solved t*, B* and numerical convergence constants for two B values; finite tests not used as universal orbit proof.
